_about: Assumed inputs, schemas and preregistered parameters for 4.8 leaf-off optical. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Change freely. Path specs resolve through expkit: {key, rel}, {exp, rel}, {area, rel}. 'assumed': true marks an input not held (VERIFY).

areas._warren_note: Warren bbox not on file in the repo on 2026-11-05 (VERIFY). Coverage is computed for 9t only until it is set

prereg.min_coverage_note: Judged share of sampled chips needed before the usable-share gate decides. 2026-11-06 user accepted default ("take defaults"). Change freely

pema_venango_2020.note: PASDA PEMAImagery2018 layer 242. URL and layers are read from notebooks/wellsight_v2/s5_eval/_pit_leafoff_geotiff_9t.py. Flight date not confirmed (VERIFY)

pema_forest.note: PASDA PEMAImagery2018 layer 110, used where Venango is blank. Flight date not confirmed (VERIFY)

naip.note: Dates from notebooks/wellsight_v2/s5_eval/_pit_naip_chip_9t.py. All four are leaf-on months, so NAIP is a negative control for season here

local_mosaic.note: Any leaf-off orthophoto mosaic downloaded as a GeoTIFF (D10). Offline chips come from it

programs.note: Coverage search log (S0). Bounds in lon/lat. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD, blank if unknown

offsets.note: Template written by S3. A person fills image_x, image_y in QGIS

reviews.note: One CSV per reviewer. visible is yes, no or cannot_tell. Reviewers are blind to lidar
